explanation: Store complete words in a set. Exact search checks membership; prefix search scans stored words and succeeds when any starts with the supplied prefix. An empty set has no matching prefix, even for the empty string.
timeComplexity: O((L+1) log(U+1)) insertion/exact-search upper bound with an ordered set; O(U(P+1)) prefix-scan upper bound for U words and prefix length P.
spaceComplexity: O(S+U) stored words/set entries; O(1) additional prefix-search workspace.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
